name: prov_gaps
description: Fix a provenance gap a query exposed - a missed input, output, variable or attribute, or a function or entity missed entirely because of the code's structure - by exploring the app in the annotation phase, then learning it generically in the provenance capability and for the workload. Load when the user opens a gap from the Query view.

history.why: Gaps a computed answer exposes, fixed in the annotation phase and learned generically and per workload
